body.en: Pre-calculus questions represent the highest-difficulty tier on the ACT International Subject Test (Math 1). Mastery requires evaluating algebraic limits (factoring, conjugate rationalization, and behavior at infinity), applying the Binomial Theorem for arbitrary term coefficients, converting between polar and Cartesian coordinates, and working with parametric curves and vectors.
body.ar: Pre-التفاضل والتكامل questions represent the highest-difficulty tier on the ACT International Subject Test (Math 1). Mastery requires evaluating algebraic النهايات (factoring, conjugate rationalization, and behavior at infinity), applying the Binomial مبرهنة for arbitrary term المعاملات, converting between polar and Cartesian الإحداثيات, and working with parametric curves and المتجهات.

label.en: Definition 5.1 — Limits, Continuity, and Rational Behavior
label.ar: تعريف 5.1 — النهايات, Continuity, and Rational Behavior

body.en:
Core principles of limits and continuity:
  • Limit Definition: \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = L\) means that \(f(x)\) gets arbitrarily close to \(L\) as \(x\) approaches \(c\) from both sides. The two-sided limit exists if and only if:
    \[ \lim_{x \to c^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to c^+} f(x) = L \]
  • Continuity: A function \(f(x)\) is continuous at \(x = c\) iff: (1) \(f(c)\) is defined, (2) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) exists, and (3) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = f(c)\).
  • Indeterminate Form \(\frac{0}{0}\): Indicates a removable discontinuity (hole). Resolve by: (a) Factoring and canceling common polynomial factors, (b) Multiplying by the conjugate radical \(\sqrt{A} + B\), or (c) Simplifying compound fractions.
  • Limits at Infinity (End Behavior): For rational functions \(R(x) = \frac{a_n x^n + \dots}{b_m x^m + \dots}\):
    If \(n < m\): \(\lim_{x \to \pm\infty} R(x) = 0\).
    If \(n = m\): \(\lim_{x \to \pm\infty} R(x) = \frac{a_n}{b_m}\).
    If \(n > m\): \(\lim_{x \to \pm\infty} R(x) = \pm\infty\) (slant/polynomial asymptote).
body.ar:
Core principles of النهايات and continuity:
  • Limit تعريف: \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = L\) means that \(f(x)\) gets arbitrarily close to \(L\) as \(x\) approaches \(c\) from both sides. The two-sided النهاية exists if and only if:
    \[ \lim_{x \to c^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to c^+} f(x) = L \]
  • Continuity: A الدالة \(f(x)\) is continuous at \(x = c\) iff: (1) \(f(c)\) is defined, (2) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) exists, and (3) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = f(c)\).
  • Indeterminate Form \(\frac{0}{0}\): Indicates a removable discontinuity (hole). Resolve by: (a) Factoring and canceling common كثيرة الحدود factors, (b) Multiplying by the conjugate radical \(\sqrt{A} + B\), or (c) Simplifying compound fractions.
  • Limits at Infinity (End Behavior): For rational الدوال \(R(x) = \frac{a_n x^n + \dots}{b_m x^m + \dots}\):
    If \(n < m\): \(\lim_{x \to \pm\infty} R(x) = 0\).
    If \(n = m\): \(\lim_{x \to \pm\infty} R(x) = \frac{a_n}{b_m}\).
    If \(n > m\): \(\lim_{x \to \pm\infty} R(x) = \pm\infty\) (slant/كثيرة الحدود خط التقارب).

label.ar: ● الحدس المفاهيمي العميق — Pre-التفاضل والتكامل Concepts

body.en: Local Linearization & Differentiability: A function \(f\) is differentiable at \(x = a\) if and only if the difference quotient \(\lim_{h \to 0} \dfrac{f(a+h) - f(a)}{h}\) exists as a finite real number. Differentiability at \(x = a\) strictly implies continuity at \(x = a\), but the converse fails at sharp corners (e.g. \(|x - 2|\)), vertical tangents, or jump discontinuities.
body.ar: Local Linearization & Differentiability: A الدالة \(f\) is differentiable at \(x = a\) if and only if the difference quotient \(\lim_{h \to 0} \dfrac{f(a+h) - f(a)}{h}\) exists as a finite real number. Differentiability at \(x = a\) strictly implies continuity at \(x = a\), but the converse fails at sharp corners (e.g. \(|x - 2|\)), vertical tangents, or jump discontinuities.

label.en: Theorem 5.1 — Binomial Theorem, Sequences, and Polar Conversions
label.ar: مبرهنة 5.1 — Binomial مبرهنة, المتتاليات, and Polar Conversions

body.en:
Theorems governing pre-calculus algebra and coordinate systems:
  • Binomial Theorem: For any non-negative integer \(n\):
    \[ (a + b)^n = \sum_{k=0}^n \binom{n}{k} a^{n-k} b^k, \qquad \binom{n}{k} = \frac{n!}{k!(n-k)!} \]The \((k+1)\)-th term in the expansion is \(T_{k+1} = \binom{n}{k} a^{n-k} b^k\).
  • Polar Coordinate Transformations:
    \[ x = r\cos\theta, \qquad y = r\sin\theta \]\[ r^2 = x^2 + y^2 \implies r = \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}, \qquad \tan\theta = \frac{y}{x} \quad (x \neq 0) \]Note: When finding \(\theta\), inspect the signs of \(x\) and \(y\) to ensure the angle lands in the correct quadrant.
  • Parametric Elimination: Given \(x = f(t)\) and \(y = g(t)\), solve for \(t\) in terms of \(x\) and substitute into \(y\), or use trig identities like \(\cos^2 t + \sin^2 t = 1\) when \(x = h + a\cos t\), \(y = k + b\sin t\).
  • Vectors in \(\mathbb{R}^2\) and \(\mathbb{R}^3\): For \(\vec{u} = \langle u_1, u_2, u_3 \rangle\) and \(\vec{v} = \langle v_1, v_2, v_3 \rangle\):
    Magnitude: \(\|\vec{u}\| = \sqrt{u_1^2 + u_2^2 + u_3^2}\).
    Dot Product: \(\vec{u} \cdot \vec{v} = u_1 v_1 + u_2 v_2 + u_3 v_3 = \|\vec{u}\| \|\vec{v}\| \cos\theta\).
    Orthogonality Condition: \(\vec{u} \perp \vec{v} \iff \vec{u} \cdot \vec{v} = 0\).
body.ar:
Theorems governing pre-التفاضل والتكامل الجبر and الإحداثي systems:
  • Binomial مبرهنة: For any non-negative integer \(n\):
    \[ (a + b)^n = \sum_{k=0}^n \binom{n}{k} a^{n-k} b^k, \qquad \binom{n}{k} = \frac{n!}{k!(n-k)!} \]The \((k+1)\)-th term in the expansion is \(T_{k+1} = \binom{n}{k} a^{n-k} b^k\).
  • Polar الإحداثي Transformations:
    \[ x = r\cos\theta, \qquad y = r\sin\theta \]\[ r^2 = x^2 + y^2 \implies r = \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}, \qquad \tan\theta = \frac{y}{x} \quad (x \neq 0) \]Note: عندما finding \(\theta\), inspect the signs of \(x\) and \(y\) to ensure the الزاوية lands in the correct quadrant.
  • Parametric Elimination: المعطيات \(x = f(t)\) and \(y = g(t)\), أوجد قيمة \(t\) in terms of \(x\) and عوّض into \(y\), or use trig المتطابقات like \(\cos^2 t + \sin^2 t = 1\) عندما \(x = h + a\cos t\), \(y = k + b\sin t\).
  • Vectors in \(\mathbb{R}^2\) and \(\mathbb{R}^3\): For \(\vec{u} = \langle u_1, u_2, u_3 \rangle\) and \(\vec{v} = \langle v_1, v_2, v_3 \rangle\):
    Magnitude: \(\|\vec{u}\| = \sqrt{u_1^2 + u_2^2 + u_3^2}\).
    Dot Product: \(\vec{u} \cdot \vec{v} = u_1 v_1 + u_2 v_2 + u_3 v_3 = \|\vec{u}\| \|\vec{v}\| \cos\theta\).
    Orthogonality Condition: \(\vec{u} \perp \vec{v} \iff \vec{u} \cdot \vec{v} = 0\).

label.en: ▲ ACT Math 2 Traps & Pitfalls — Limits, Conics & Binomial Expansion
label.ar: ▲ ACT Math 2 Traps & Pitfalls — النهايات, Conics & Binomial Expansion

body.en:
• Indeterminate Form \(0/0\) vs. Undefined: When direct substitution into \(\lim_{x \to a} \dfrac{f(x)}{g(x)}\) yields \(0/0\), the limit is indeterminate — factor and cancel the common factor \((x - a)\) or rationalize before re-evaluating. Do NOT write 'undefined' or 'does not exist'!
  • The \(k\)-th Term Index in Binomial Expansion: In the expansion of \((a+b)^n\), the general term is \(T_{k+1} = \binom{n}{k} a^{n-k} b^k\). The 4th term corresponds to index \(k = 3\), not \(k = 4\)! Watch negative signs when expanding expressions like \((2x - 3)^n\).
  • Polar Coordinate Ambiguity: A Cartesian point \((x, y)\) has infinitely many polar representations: \((r, \theta)\), \((-r, \theta + \pi)\), and \((r, \theta + 2k\pi)\). Always verify if \(r\) is positive or negative in multiple-choice options.
  • Infinite Series Ratio Magnitude: For \(\sum a_1 r^{n-1}\), if \(|r| \ge 1\), the series diverges, so applying \(S = \dfrac{a_1}{1-r}\) produces a false number.
body.ar:
• Indeterminate Form \(0/0\) vs. Undefined: عندما direct substitution into \(\lim_{x \to a} \dfrac{f(x)}{g(x)}\) yields \(0/0\), the النهاية is indeterminate — factor and cancel the common factor \((x - a)\) or rationalize before re-evaluating. Do NOT write 'undefined' or 'does not exist'!
  • The \(k\)-th Term Index in Binomial Expansion: In the expansion of \((a+b)^n\), the general term is \(T_{k+1} = \binom{n}{k} a^{n-k} b^k\). The 4th term corresponds to index \(k = 3\), not \(k = 4\)! Watch negative signs عندما expanding expressions like \((2x - 3)^n\).
  • Polar الإحداثي Ambiguity: A Cartesian point \((x, y)\) has infinitely many polar representations: \((r, \theta)\), \((-r, \theta + \pi)\), and \((r, \theta + 2k\pi)\). Always verify if \(r\) is positive or negative in multiple-choice options.
  • Infinite المتسلسلة Ratio Magnitude: For \(\sum a_1 r^{n-1}\), if \(|r| \ge 1\), the المتسلسلة diverges, so applying \(S = \dfrac{a_1}{1-r}\) produces a false number.

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Pre-Calculus Concepts)
label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — First-Principles اشتقاق (Pre-التفاضل والتكامل Concepts)

body.en:
Why Differentiability Implies Continuity & How Implicit Differentiation Works: Notice that for \(x \ne a\), we can write \(f(x) - f(a) = \dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\cdot (x - a)\). Taking the limit as \(x \to a\) by the Product Law gives:

\[ \lim_{x \to a} \bigl(f(x) - f(a)\bigr) = f'(a)\cdot 0 = 0 \implies \lim_{x \to a} f(x) = f(a) \]

Similarly, when differentiating an implicit relation \(F(x, y) = c\) with respect to \(x\), \(y = y(x)\) is an inner function of \(x\). By the Chain Rule, \(\dfrac{d}{dx}\bigl[y^n\bigr] = ny^{n-1}\dfrac{dy}{dx}\), and for product terms \(\dfrac{d}{dx}[xy] = y + x\dfrac{dy}{dx}\).
body.ar:
Why Differentiability Implies Continuity & How Implicit Differentiation Works: Notice that for \(x \ne a\), we can write \(f(x) - f(a) = \dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\cdot (x - a)\). Taking the النهاية as \(x \to a\) by the Product Law gives:

\[ \lim_{x \to a} \bigl(f(x) - f(a)\bigr) = f'(a)\cdot 0 = 0 \implies \lim_{x \to a} f(x) = f(a) \]

Similarly, عندما differentiating an implicit relation \(F(x, y) = c\) بالنسبة إلى \(x\), \(y = y(x)\) is an inner الدالة of \(x\). By the Chain Rule, \(\dfrac{d}{dx}\bigl[y^n\bigr] = ny^{n-1}\dfrac{dy}{dx}\), and for product terms \(\dfrac{d}{dx}[xy] = y + x\dfrac{dy}{dx}\).

label.en: Worked Example 5.A — Evaluating Limits via Conjugate Rationalization
label.ar: مثال محلول 5.A — Evaluating النهايات via Conjugate Rationalization

body.en:
Evaluate the limit \(\lim_{x \to 4} \dfrac{\sqrt{x} - 2}{x - 4}\).

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Test direct substitution: \(x = 4\) yields \(\frac{\sqrt{4} - 2}{4 - 4} = \frac{0}{0}\), which is indeterminate.
  2. Multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate of the numerator, \(\sqrt{x} + 2\):
    \[ \lim_{x \to 4} \frac{(\sqrt{x} - 2)(\sqrt{x} + 2)}{(x - 4)(\sqrt{x} + 2)} \]
  3. Simplify the numerator using the difference of squares \((\sqrt{x})^2 - 2^2 = x - 4\):
    \[ \lim_{x \to 4} \frac{x - 4}{(x - 4)(\sqrt{x} + 2)} \]
  4. Cancel the non-zero common factor \((x - 4)\) (since \(x \neq 4\)):
    \[ \lim_{x \to 4} \frac{1}{\sqrt{x} + 2} \]
  5. Evaluate by direct substitution:
    \[ \frac{1}{\sqrt{4} + 2} = \frac{1}{2 + 2} = \mathbf{\frac{1}{4}} \]
The limit is \(\mathbf{\frac{1}{4}} = 0.25\).
body.ar:
احسب قيمة النهاية \(\lim_{x \to 4} \dfrac{\sqrt{x} - 2}{x - 4}\).

Step-by-step الحل:
  1. Test direct substitution: \(x = 4\) yields \(\frac{\sqrt{4} - 2}{4 - 4} = \frac{0}{0}\), which is indeterminate.
  2. Multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate of the numerator, \(\sqrt{x} + 2\):
    \[ \lim_{x \to 4} \frac{(\sqrt{x} - 2)(\sqrt{x} + 2)}{(x - 4)(\sqrt{x} + 2)} \]
  3. Simplify the numerator using the difference of squares \((\sqrt{x})^2 - 2^2 = x - 4\):
    \[ \lim_{x \to 4} \frac{x - 4}{(x - 4)(\sqrt{x} + 2)} \]
  4. Cancel the non-zero common factor \((x - 4)\) (since \(x \neq 4\)):
    \[ \lim_{x \to 4} \frac{1}{\sqrt{x} + 2} \]
  5. Evaluate by direct substitution:
    \[ \frac{1}{\sqrt{4} + 2} = \frac{1}{2 + 2} = \mathbf{\frac{1}{4}} \]
The النهاية is \(\mathbf{\frac{1}{4}} = 0.25\).

label.en: Worked Example 5.B — Finding the Constant Term in a Binomial Expansion
label.ar: مثال محلول 5.B — Finding the الثابت Term in a Binomial Expansion

body.en:
Find the constant term (independent of \(x\)) in the binomial expansion of \(\left(2x^2 - \dfrac{1}{x}\right)^9\).

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Write the general term \(T_{k+1}\) using the binomial theorem with \(n = 9\), \(a = 2x^2\), and \(b = -x^{-1}\):
    \[ T_{k+1} = \binom{9}{k} (2x^2)^{9-k} (-x^{-1})^k \]\[ T_{k+1} = \binom{9}{k} 2^{9-k} (-1)^k (x^2)^{9-k} (x^{-1})^k = \binom{9}{k} 2^{9-k} (-1)^k x^{18 - 2k - k} = \binom{9}{k} 2^{9-k} (-1)^k x^{18 - 3k} \]
  2. Set the exponent of \(x\) to \(0\) for a constant term:
    \[ 18 - 3k = 0 \implies 3k = 18 \implies k = 6 \]Since \(k = 6\), this is the \((6+1) = 7\)-th term.
  3. Calculate the coefficient with \(k = 6\):
    \[ \binom{9}{6} = \binom{9}{3} = \frac{9 \times 8 \times 7}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = 84 \]\[ 2^{9-6} = 2^3 = 8 \]\[ (-1)^6 = 1 \]
  4. Multiply the components:
    \[ T_7 = 84 \times 8 \times 1 = \mathbf{672} \]
The constant term is \(\mathbf{672}\).
body.ar:
أوجد الثابت term (independent of \(x\)) in the binomial expansion of \(\left(2x^2 - \dfrac{1}{x}\right)^9\).

Step-by-step الحل:
  1. Write the general term \(T_{k+1}\) using the binomial المبرهنة with \(n = 9\), \(a = 2x^2\), and \(b = -x^{-1}\):
    \[ T_{k+1} = \binom{9}{k} (2x^2)^{9-k} (-x^{-1})^k \]\[ T_{k+1} = \binom{9}{k} 2^{9-k} (-1)^k (x^2)^{9-k} (x^{-1})^k = \binom{9}{k} 2^{9-k} (-1)^k x^{18 - 2k - k} = \binom{9}{k} 2^{9-k} (-1)^k x^{18 - 3k} \]
  2. Set the exponent of \(x\) to \(0\) for a الثابت term:
    \[ 18 - 3k = 0 \implies 3k = 18 \implies k = 6 \]Since \(k = 6\), this is the \((6+1) = 7\)-th term.
  3. Calculate the المعامل with \(k = 6\):
    \[ \binom{9}{6} = \binom{9}{3} = \frac{9 \times 8 \times 7}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = 84 \]\[ 2^{9-6} = 2^3 = 8 \]\[ (-1)^6 = 1 \]
  4. Multiply the components:
    \[ T_7 = 84 \times 8 \times 1 = \mathbf{672} \]
The الثابت term is \(\mathbf{672}\).

label.en: Worked Example 5.C — Polar Equation to Cartesian Conic Form
label.ar: مثال محلول 5.C — Polar المعادلة to Cartesian Conic Form

body.en:
Convert the polar equation \(r = 6\cos\theta\) into Cartesian coordinates, and identify the geometric figure, center, and radius.

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Multiply both sides of the equation by \(r\):
    \[ r^2 = 6r\cos\theta \]
  2. Substitute the Cartesian relationships \(r^2 = x^2 + y^2\) and \(x = r\cos\theta\):
    \[ x^2 + y^2 = 6x \]
  3. Rearrange all terms to one side and complete the square for \(x\):
    \[ (x^2 - 6x) + y^2 = 0 \]\[ (x^2 - 6x + 9) + y^2 = 9 \]\[ (x - 3)^2 + y^2 = 3^2 \]
This is a circle with center \(\mathbf{(3, 0)}\) and radius \(\mathbf{r = 3}\).
body.ar:
Convert the polar المعادلة \(r = 6\cos\theta\) into Cartesian الإحداثيات, and identify the geometric الشكل, center, and نصف القطر.

Step-by-step الحل:
  1. Multiply both sides of the المعادلة by \(r\):
    \[ r^2 = 6r\cos\theta \]
  2. Substitute the Cartesian relationships \(r^2 = x^2 + y^2\) and \(x = r\cos\theta\):
    \[ x^2 + y^2 = 6x \]
  3. Rearrange all terms to one side and complete the square for \(x\):
    \[ (x^2 - 6x) + y^2 = 0 \]\[ (x^2 - 6x + 9) + y^2 = 9 \]\[ (x - 3)^2 + y^2 = 3^2 \]
This is a circle with center \(\mathbf{(3, 0)}\) and نصف القطر \(\mathbf{r = 3}\).

label.ar: مثال محلول \(D\) — Pre-التفاضل والتكامل Concepts (Medium Application)

body.en:
Problem (Medium): The function \( f \) is defined by \[ f(x) = \frac{2x^2 + kx - 6}{x - 2} \] for all real numbers \( x \neq 2 \), where \( k \) is a constant. If the graph of \( y = f(x) \) in the standard \( (x, y) \) coordinate plane has a removable discontinuity (a hole) at the point \( (2, L) \), what is the value of \( L \)?

Step-by-Step Solution: A rational function has a removable discontinuity at \( x = 2 \) if and only if both the numerator and the denominator share the factor \( (x - 2) \). Therefore, the numerator must equal 0 when \( x = 2 \): \[ 2(2)^2 + k(2) - 6 = 0 \] \[ 8 + 2k - 6 = 0 \] \[ 2k + 2 = 0 \implies k = -1 \] Now, substitute \( k = -1 \) back into the numerator and factor it: \[ 2x^2 - x - 6 = (x - 2)(2x + 3) \] For all \( x \neq 2 \), simplify \( f(x) \): \[ f(x) = \frac{(x - 2)(2x + 3)}{x - 2} = 2x + 3 \] The \( y \)-coordinate \( L \) of the removable discontinuity is the limit of \( f(x) \) as \( x \to 2 \): \[ L = 2(2) + 3 = 7 \] Common traps: - Finding \( k = -1 \) and stopping there leads to choice A. - Incorrectly assuming the simplified linear factor is \( 2x - 1 \) (using the value of \( k \)) leads to \( 2(2) - 1 = 3 \), choice B.
body.ar:
Problem (Medium): The الدالة \( f \) is defined by \[ f(x) = \frac{2x^2 + kx - 6}{x - 2} \] for all real numbers \( x \neq 2 \), حيث \( k \) is a الثابت. If the التمثيل البياني of \( y = f(x) \) in the standard \( (x, y) \) الإحداثي plane has a removable discontinuity (a hole) at the point \( (2, L) \), what is the value of \( L \)?

Step-by-Step الحل: A rational الدالة has a removable discontinuity at \( x = 2 \) if and only if both the numerator and the denominator share the factor \( (x - 2) \). وبالتالي, the numerator must equal 0 عندما \( x = 2 \): \[ 2(2)^2 + k(2) - 6 = 0 \] \[ 8 + 2k - 6 = 0 \] \[ 2k + 2 = 0 \implies k = -1 \] Now, عوّض \( k = -1 \) back into the numerator and factor it: \[ 2x^2 - x - 6 = (x - 2)(2x + 3) \] For all \( x \neq 2 \), بسّط \( f(x) \): \[ f(x) = \frac{(x - 2)(2x + 3)}{x - 2} = 2x + 3 \] The \( y \)-الإحداثي \( L \) of the removable discontinuity is the النهاية of \( f(x) \) as \( x \to 2 \): \[ L = 2(2) + 3 = 7 \] Common traps: - Finding \( k = -1 \) and stopping there leads to choice A. - Incorrectly assuming the simplified linear factor is \( 2x - 1 \) (using the value of \( k \)) leads to \( 2(2) - 1 = 3 \), choice B.

question.en: Evaluate the limit \(\lim_{x \to 3} \dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3}\) algebraically, and interpret what happens to the graph of \(f(x) = \dfrac{x^2-9}{x-3}\) at \(x = 3\).
question.ar: احسب قيمة النهاية \(\lim_{x \to 3} \dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3}\) algebraically, and interpret what happens to the graph of \(f(x) = \dfrac{x^2-9}{x-3}\) at \(x = 3\).

solution.en:
Step 1 (Factor and Cancel): Direct substitution gives \(\frac{0}{0}\). Factor the numerator as a difference of squares:
\[ \lim_{x \to 3} \frac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{x - 3} = \lim_{x \to 3} (x + 3) \]

Step 2 (Evaluate Limit): Substitute \(x = 3\):
\[ 3 + 3 = \mathbf{6} \]

Geometric Interpretation: At \(x = 3\), the graph of \(f(x)\) has a removable discontinuity (a hole) at point \(\mathbf{(3, 6)}\); for all other points, the graph is the straight line \(y = x + 3\).

question.en: Find the 4th term in the binomial expansion of \((2x - 3)^6\).
question.ar: أوجد 4th term in the binomial expansion of \((2x - 3)^6\).

solution.en: Using the binomial theorem general term formula \(T_{k+1} = \binom{n}{k} a^{n-k} b^k\) with \(n = 6\), \(a = 2x\), \(b = -3\), and \(k = 3\) (for the 4th term): \[ T_4 = \binom{6}{3} (2x)^{6-3} (-3)^3. \] Compute the binomial coefficient: \(\binom{6}{3} = \dfrac{6 \times 5 \times 4}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = 20\). \[ T_4 = 20 \cdot (2x)^3 \cdot (-27) = 20 \cdot (8x^3) \cdot (-27) = \mathbf{-4320x^3}. \]

question.en: Convert the polar equation \(r = 8\sin\theta\) into rectangular coordinates, and find its center and radius.
question.ar: Convert the polar equation \(r = 8\sin\theta\) into rectangular coordinates, and أوجد its center and radius.

solution.en:
Multiply both sides by \(r\):
\[ r^2 = 8r\sin\theta \]
Substitute \(r^2 = x^2 + y^2\) and \(y = r\sin\theta\):
\[ x^2 + y^2 = 8y \implies x^2 + (y^2 - 8y + 16) = 16 \implies \mathbf{x^2 + (y - 4)^2 = 16} \]
This is a circle with center \(\mathbf{(0, 4)}\) and radius \(\mathbf{r = 4}\).

This is a circle with center \(\mathbf{(0, 4)}\) and radius \(\mathbf{r = 4}\).

question.en: Given vectors \(\vec{u} = \langle 3, -4, 2 \rangle\) and \(\vec{v} = \langle 2, 1, k \rangle\), find the value of \(k\) such that \(\vec{u}\) and \(\vec{v}\) are orthogonal.
question.ar: Given vectors \(\vec{u} = \langle 3, -4, 2 \rangle\) and \(\vec{v} = \langle 2, 1, k \rangle\), أوجد قيمة \(k\) such that \(\vec{u}\) and \(\vec{v}\) are orthogonal.

solution.en:
Two non-zero vectors are orthogonal if and only if their dot product equals zero:
\[ \vec{u} \cdot \vec{v} = 0 \]\[ (3)(2) + (-4)(1) + (2)(k) = 0 \]\[ 6 - 4 + 2k = 0 \implies 2 + 2k = 0 \implies 2k = -2 \implies \mathbf{k = -1} \]
solution.ar:

question.en: What is the period of the function \( f(x) = 3\cos(2x) \)?
question.ar: حل المسألة التالية في (Pre-Calculus Concepts): What is the period of the function \( f(x) = 3\cos(2x) \)?

hints.en: The standard form of a cosine function is \( f(x) = A\cos(Bx) \), where the amplitude is \( |A| \) and the period is \( \dfrac{2\pi}{|B|} \).
hints.ar: The standard form of a cosine function is \( f(x) = A\cos(Bx) \), حيث the amplitude is \( |A| \) and the period is \( \dfrac{2\pi}{|B|} \).

hints.en: For the function \( f(x) = 3\cos(2x) \), the coefficient of \( x \) is \( B = 2 \).
hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \( f(x) = 3\cos(2x) \) ، \( x \) ، \( B = 2 \) لتبسيط الخطوة.
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(\text{Period} = \dfrac{2\pi}{2}\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

solution.en:
The standard form of a cosine function is \( f(x) = A\cos(Bx) \), where the amplitude is \( |A| \) and the period is \( \dfrac{2\pi}{|B|} \).

For the function \( f(x) = 3\cos(2x) \), the coefficient of \( x \) is \( B = 2 \).

Applying the period formula:
\[ \text{Period} = \dfrac{2\pi}{2} = \pi \]

Common misconceptions:
- Choice A (\( \frac{\pi}{2} \)) comes from incorrectly dividing \( \pi \) by \( B \) (the formula for the period of tangent).
- Choice C (\( 2\pi \)) forgets to account for the horizontal compression factor \( B = 2 \).
- Choice D (\( 4\pi \)) mistakenly multiplies \( 2\pi \) by \( 2 \) rather than dividing.
solution.ar:
The standard form of a cosine function is \( f(x) = A\cos(Bx) \), حيث the amplitude is \( |A| \) and the period is \( \dfrac{2\pi}{|B|} \).

For the function \( f(x) = 3\cos(2x) \), the coefficient of \( x \) is \( B = 2 \).

Applying the period formula:
\[ \text{Period} = \dfrac{2\pi}{2} = \pi \]

Common misconceptions:
- Choice A (\( \frac{\pi}{2} \)) comes from incorrectly dividing \( \pi \) by \( B \) (the formula for the period of tangent).
- Choice C (\( 2\pi \)) forgets to account for the horizontal compression حلّل \( B = 2 \).
- Choice D (\( 4\pi \)) mistakenly multiplies \( 2\pi \) by \( 2 \) rather than dividing.

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
